name: Amazon ECS Express Mode
line: Deploy container apps on ECS with generated load balancing and scaling.

free.text: AWS account credits; no recurring Express hosting bundle

work.math: Known base price for a static site. The load balancer (ALB), task and IP address usage, plus logs and data transfer, can change the full total.
Known base price for a small app API. Logs, overlapping tasks, overlapping IP addresses and data transfer can still change the total.
Known base price for app plus Postgres, including a $13.98 database cost. Backups, logs, routing and task charges vary.
